pages.title: Shattered Soul Shards
pages.text: Occultists have discovered a way to capture part of the essence$(br) of any fallen enemy through an enchantment known as $(#55FF55)Fracture Soul$().$(br2)With a variation of the ritual to resurrect familiars,$(br) it is possible $()

pages.title: Shattered Soul Shards
pages.text: for a $(item)Shattered Soul Shard$() to create a completely revived mob,$(br) forming its new body and trapping within it the shard's remaining soul.$(br)
